
## Market today: gross spending on GLP-1 and GIP products reached $`r kn("m_spend_partd_2024")` billion in Part D and $`r kn("m_spend_medicaid_2024")` billion in Medicaid in 2024, before rebates

```{r a3, results='asis'}
fig("50_spending_trend", 520)
src("Source: CMS Medicare Part D Spending by Drug and Medicaid Spending by Drug (gross of rebates). Part D spending includes diabetes and other covered uses, not only obesity.")
```

## Landscape: injectables, new oral options, a Medicare Bridge and a $`r kn("x_price_245")` price are arriving while some states end coverage

- **Products.** Wegovy (injection and tablets), Zepbound (KwikPen) and Foundayo (tablets) are covered under the Medicare GLP-1 Bridge (CMS prescriber page, June 2026).
- **Medicare GLP-1 Bridge.** A short-term demonstration, `r kn("x_bridge_window")`, with a $`r kn("x_bridge_copay")` copay (CMS).
- **Price.** The White House (November 2025) announced a Medicare price of $`r kn("x_price_245")` a month for these drugs and said state Medicaid programs will have access at those prices.
- **State coverage is changing:** several states ended or paused coverage in late 2025 and early 2026 (timeline on the next slide).
- **Pipeline.** `r kn("p_obesity_studies")` registered studies of the in-scope ingredients list obesity; `r kn("p_obesity_phase3_ongoing")` are ongoing Phase 3, and oral orforglipron has `r kn("p_orforglipron_phase3_obesity_studies")` Phase 3 studies (ClinicalTrials.gov; other ingredients not counted).

```{r a4, results='asis'}
src("Sources: CMS Medicare GLP-1 Bridge pages (saved under docs/sources); White House fact sheet, November 2025; state Medicaid documents; ClinicalTrials.gov (registry last updated 2026-10-02).")
```

## Recommendations: considerations for a brand or access lead, from the evidence above

| Finding | So what | What a brand or access lead might consider |
|---|---|---|
| Coverage was associated with an estimated `r kn("c_att_overall")` additional prescriptions per 1,000 enrollees per quarter, growing over eight quarters | Uptake builds over about two years rather than at launch | Planning access support over a multi-year ramp instead of a launch spike |
| Coverage runs through managed care in South Carolina and Rhode Island | Decisions sit with managed-care organizations as well as state programs | Evidence and criteria materials aimed at managed-care medical and pharmacy directors (to be tested in the research pack) |
| Coverage ended in California and Pennsylvania (`r kn("c_withdraw_ca")`% and `r kn("c_withdraw_pa")`%, preliminary) | Budget predictability decides whether coverage lasts | Showing a clear range of cost scenarios: $`r kn("e_pmpm")` per enrollee per month at the central rebate, $`r kn("e_announced_pmpm")` at the announced price |
| Primary care and nurse practitioners and physician assistants wrote `r kn("d_share_pcp")`% and `r kn("d_share_nppa")`% of Part D incretin claims | The prescriber base is broad, not specialist | Weighing primary-care reach (Part D shows diabetes and other covered uses; confirm for obesity with other data) |
| The rebate is unknown and drives the range ($`r kn("e_scen_min")` to $`r kn("e_scen_max")` million) | Public data cannot settle net cost | Treating the budget range as a conversation starter and checking it against a payer's own net price |

## Appendix: data, methods and limits

- **Data.** CMS Medicaid State Drug Utilization Data and enrollment, Medicare Part D Prescribers, NADAC, NHANES, MEPS, KFF polls, FDA labels and state Medicaid documents; all public aggregate data. `r kn("build_models")` dbt models, `r kn("build_tests")` tests.
- **Methods.** Callaway and Sant'Anna difference-in-differences (staggered adoption) with imputation of suppressed cells; survey-weighted NHANES estimates; ISPOR-style budget impact model with a probabilistic sensitivity analysis.
- **Limits.** Gross, not net, of rebates; ten covering states; eligibility is a lower bound; Part D is not obesity use; scenarios, not forecasts.
- **Links.** Interactive budget model (https://01a108a8-ecde-397c-5353-39196812b10c.share.connect.posit.cloud/), report (`report/report.html`), plans and deviations (`analysis/outputs/deviations.md`), key numbers (`analysis/outputs/key_numbers.csv`), repository github.com/erickyegon/incretin-access-value.
- No company affiliation or endorsement. I used AI tools to help write code and documentation. The study design, methods and conclusions are my own, and I verified all results.
